name: button
summary: A button that springs down on press, in eleven variants including gradient and glow.
props: Solid primary / accent / secondary / danger fill, bordered outline, transparent ghost, tinted soft, underlined link, two-tone gradient, accent with a coloured glow, or a raised elevated surface.
Stretches to the parent's width (alignSelf: stretch).
Any colour; recolours every tinted variant and picks readable text automatically.
color shifted 38° on the hue wheel
Style for the label text (merged over size and variant typography).
Style for the outer animated wrapper (margins, alignment); the pressable surface keeps its own.
behavior: Scales down with a spring on press-in and bounces back on release. loading swaps the label for a spinner and blocks presses.
Opt-in light impact on press with haptics; off by default.
A button with disabled and busy state.
usage:
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

<Button variant="accent" size="lg" block onPress={checkout}>
  Continue to payment
</Button>
